method: Playwright CLI attached to the built Electron application over CDP and browsing the running Next.js application. Complete application viewports; no element crops, pixel editing, DOM text changes, CSS changes, or compositing.
dataScope: Explicit screenshot fixtures in a disposable Git repository and SQLite profile. Four local Runs, 16 artifacts (15 in the first batch), 3 reviews, 7 illustrative stage-usage records and 2 authored conversations. Three TestEvidence records contain actual sample-project output: 14 passing checks. Implementation includes the actual sample Git diff; PR preview is authored and not a real Delivery Intent. Desktop is unpaired; fixture outbox entries were cleared before launch. First Web overview uses redacted API uploads. Additional Web captures seed full eight-node Run graphs and artifact summaries in the isolated API before startup, then upload test/review summaries through normal endpoints. Three Work Requests, a budget policy and two demo approvals use normal endpoints; Recommended Team Policy v2 is saved through the Web editor. Filled request, review and budget forms are unsent drafts. No paid model calls, real GitHub delivery, existing user profile or production data.
